import hashlib,json,os,pathlib,subprocess,sys,time
assert os.geteuid()==0
bundle=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]);expected=sys.argv[2];expiry=float(sys.argv[3])
assert hashlib.sha256(bundle.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==expected
b=json.loads(bundle.read_text());assert b['status']=='FROZEN_EXECUTION_PLAN_REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW'
assert len(b['attempts'])==4 and len({a['run_id'] for a in b['attempts']})==4
assert time.time()+b['full_max_seconds']<expiry,'full block budget unavailable'
claims=pathlib.Path(b['claims_root']);assert claims.is_dir() and claims.stat().st_uid==0 and claims.stat().st_mode&0o777==0o700

def claim(name):
 fd=os.open(claims/name,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
 with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as f:
  json.dump({'pid':os.getpid(),'wall':time.time(),'monotonic':time.monotonic(),'expiry':expiry},f);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())

def native_properties(unit,deadline,allow_not_found=False):
 remaining=deadline-time.monotonic();assert remaining>0,'native controller query deadline exhausted'
 keys='Id,LoadState,ActiveState,SubState,MainPID,ExecMainPID,ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic,ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic,ExecMainCode,ExecMainStatus,Result,NRestarts,InvocationID'
 result=subprocess.run(['/usr/bin/systemctl','show',unit,'--property='+keys],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=min(3,remaining),check=True)
 value=dict(line.split('=',1) for line in result.stdout.splitlines() if '=' in line)
 assert value['Id']==unit and (value['LoadState']=='loaded' or allow_not_found and value['LoadState']=='not-found'),'child unit not authenticated'
 return value

def native_unit_receipt(a,unit,value,error=None):
 start=int(value.get('ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic','0')) if value.get('ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic','0').isdecimal() else 0;end=int(value.get('ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic','0')) if value.get('ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic','0').isdecimal() else 0
 proof={'status':'MISSING'}
 try:
  boot=pathlib.Path('/proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id').read_text().strip();collector=os.readlink('/proc/self/ns/time');manager=os.readlink('/proc/1/ns/time')
  proof={'status':'MISSING','boot_id':boot,'collector_time_namespace':collector,'manager_time_namespace':manager,'monotonic_clock_implementation':time.get_clock_info('monotonic').implementation,'collector_pid':os.getpid()}
  assert boot and collector==manager,'systemd manager/collector time namespace differs'
  phase=runs/a['run_id']/'event-common_environment_begin.json'
  assert phase.is_file() and not phase.is_symlink() and phase.stat().st_size<=2<<20,'child clock event unavailable'
  raw=phase.read_bytes();event=json.loads(raw);clock=event['clock_identity'];pin=a.get('native_identity_pin',{})
  assert event['run_id']==a['run_id'] and event['source_commit']==b['source_commit'] and event['protocol_sha256']==b['protocol_sha256'],'child event run/source/protocol mismatch'
  assert event['pid']==int(value.get('ExecMainPID','0'))==pin.get('ExecMainPID') and value.get('InvocationID')==pin.get('InvocationID'),'child event/native process identity mismatch'
  assert type(clock.get('process_startticks')) is int and clock['process_startticks']>0 and clock['process_startticks']==pin.get('process_startticks'),'child process startticks not bound'
  assert hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==pin.get('phase_event_sha256'),'child phase event changed since native identity pin'
  proof['child_phase_clock_identity']=clock
  proof['identity_provenance']='Exact retained native invocation/ExecMainPID bound to same-run root-produced self-clock event SHA/startticks; no fabricated post-exit proc identity.'
  assert (clock['boot_id'],clock['time_namespace'],clock['monotonic_clock_implementation'])==(boot,collector,proof['monotonic_clock_implementation']),'child phase/systemd clock domain mismatch'
  proof.update(status='VALID',child_phase_event_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
 except Exception as clock_error:proof.update(status='MISSING',error_type=type(clock_error).__name__,error=str(clock_error))
 pin=a.get('native_identity_pin',{});owned=value.get('InvocationID')==a.get('native_invocation_pin') and value.get('ExecMainPID','0').isdecimal() and int(value.get('ExecMainPID','0'))==pin.get('ExecMainPID')
 observed=owned and start>0 and end>=start and end>0 and int(value['ExecMainPID'])>0
 code=value.get('ExecMainCode');status=value.get('ExecMainStatus')
 return {'schema':'kimi-controller-native-unit-span-v1','run_id':a['run_id'],'unit':unit,'source_commit':b['source_commit'],'protocol_sha256':b['protocol_sha256'],'command_sha256':a['command_sha256'],'spec_sha256':a['spec_sha256'],'systemd_properties':dict(value),'native_start_us':start if start>0 else None,'native_exit_us':end if end>0 else None,'start_ns':start*1000 if observed else None,'end_ns':end*1000 if observed else None,'span_ns':(end-start)*1000 if observed else None,'clock_proof':proof,'precision':'systemd integer microseconds; multiplication does not add precision','observation_status':'OBSERVED' if observed else 'NOT_OBSERVED_NATIVE_ENDPOINT','termination_class':'NORMAL_EXIT0' if observed and code=='1' and status=='0' and value.get('Result')=='success' else 'NONZERO_EXIT' if observed and code=='1' else 'SIGNAL_OR_FORCED' if observed else 'NOT_OBSERVED','error':error,'scope':'Exact child main process entry through process exit; failed/forced span is not normal cleanup proof; excludes parent launch and later external release.'}

def native_controller_wait(a,argv,spec,deadline):
 unit=next(v.split('=',1)[1] for v in argv if v.startswith('--unit='));value={};pin=None;invocation=None;primary=None
 try:
  assert '--wait' not in argv and '--property=RemainAfterExit=yes' in argv,'retained child launch required'
  launch=subprocess.run(argv,timeout=min(30,deadline-time.monotonic()))
  a['launch_returncode']=launch.returncode
  assert launch.returncode==0,'systemd child start request failed or outcome uncertain'
  while True:
   value=native_properties(unit,deadline)
   assert value['NRestarts']=='0','child unit restarted'
   assert value['InvocationID'],'child invocation unavailable'
   if invocation is None:invocation=value['InvocationID'];a['native_invocation_pin']=invocation
   else:assert invocation==value['InvocationID'],'child invocation drift before PID pin'
   pid=int(value['ExecMainPID'])
   if pin is None and pid>0:
    pin=(value['InvocationID'],pid);a['native_identity_pin']={'InvocationID':pin[0],'ExecMainPID':pin[1]}
   if pin is not None:
    assert (value['InvocationID'],pid)==pin,'child invocation/PID drift'
    phase=runs/a['run_id']/'event-common_environment_begin.json'
    if phase.is_file() and 'process_startticks' not in a['native_identity_pin']:
     assert not phase.is_symlink() and phase.stat().st_size<=2<<20,'untrusted child event'
     raw=phase.read_bytes();event=json.loads(raw);clock=event['clock_identity']
     assert event['run_id']==a['run_id'] and event['source_commit']==b['source_commit'] and event['protocol_sha256']==b['protocol_sha256'] and event['pid']==pid,'child initial event/native identity mismatch'
     assert type(clock.get('process_startticks')) is int and clock['process_startticks']>0,'child initial startticks unavailable'
     a['native_identity_pin'].update(process_startticks=clock['process_startticks'],phase_event_sha256=hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest())
   start=int(value['ExecMainStartTimestampMonotonic']);end=int(value['ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic'])
   assert int(value['MainPID']) in (0,pid),'child MainPID differs from execution PID'
   if int(value['MainPID'])==0 and end>0 and value['ActiveState'] in ('active','inactive','failed') and value['SubState'] in ('exited','dead','failed'):
    assert pin is not None and start>0 and end>=start,'native process endpoints unavailable'
    receipt=native_unit_receipt(a,unit,value)
    a['native_unit_span']=receipt
    path=claims/(a['run_id']+'-controller-unit-span.json')
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as stream:json.dump(receipt,stream);stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    a['native_unit_span_ref']={'path':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
    assert receipt['clock_proof']['status']=='VALID','native controller/phase clock proof unavailable'
    if value['ExecMainCode']!='1' or value['ExecMainStatus']!='0' or value['Result']!='success':raise subprocess.CalledProcessError(int(value['ExecMainStatus']) or 1,argv)
    return subprocess.CompletedProcess(argv,0)
   assert time.monotonic()+.2<deadline,'native child wait budget exhausted'
   time.sleep(.2)
 except BaseException as error:
  primary=error
  a['native_unit_span']=native_unit_receipt(a,unit,value,{'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)})
  try:
   a['owned_abort_release']=native_abort_release(a,unit,spec,deadline)
   terminal=a['owned_abort_release'].get('terminal_native_properties')
   if terminal:
    a['native_unit_span_after_abort']=native_unit_receipt(a,unit,terminal,{'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)})
    path=claims/(a['run_id']+'-controller-unit-span-after-abort.json')
    fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL,0o600)
    with os.fdopen(fd,'w') as stream:json.dump(a['native_unit_span_after_abort'],stream);stream.flush();os.fsync(stream.fileno())
    a['native_unit_span_after_abort_ref']={'path':str(path),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
  except BaseException as cleanup_error:a['owned_abort_release']={'status':'INCOMPLETE','error_type':type(cleanup_error).__name__,'error':str(cleanup_error),'independent_guard_coverage_retained':True}
  raise primary

def native_abort_release(a,unit,spec,deadline):
 # Revisit exact known unit names and late directories until release or original cap.
 root=runs/a['run_id'];started=set();errors=[];states={}
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  for name in ('guard-head','guard-worker','observer'):
   directory=root/name
   if directory.exists():
    info=directory.lstat();assert directory.is_dir() and not directory.is_symlink() and info.st_uid==0 and info.st_mode&0o777==0o700,'untrusted owned abort directory'
    marker=directory/'ABORT'
    if not marker.exists():
     fd=os.open(marker,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600);os.close(fd)
    else:assert marker.is_file() and not marker.is_symlink() and marker.stat().st_uid==0,'untrusted abort marker'
  try:
   state=native_properties(unit,deadline);pin=a.get('native_identity_pin')
   if a.get('native_invocation_pin'):assert state['InvocationID']==a['native_invocation_pin'],'owned child invocation changed during abort'
   if pin:assert state['InvocationID']==pin['InvocationID'] and int(state['ExecMainPID'])==pin['ExecMainPID'],'owned child invocation changed during abort'
   child_done=int(state['MainPID'])==0 and int(state['ExecMainExitTimestampMonotonic'])>0
   done=child_done
   for name in ('guard-head','guard-worker','observer'):
    guardunit=a['run_id']+('-observer.service' if name=='observer' else '-'+name.removeprefix('guard-')+'-guard.service')
    guard=native_properties(guardunit,deadline,allow_not_found=True);directory=root/name
    if guard['LoadState']=='not-found':
     producer_markers=('guard-events.jsonl','ARMED.json','GO.json','GO-ACK.json','guard-final.json','observer-ready.json','observer-final.json')
     published=directory.exists() and any((directory/marker).exists() for marker in producer_markers)
     if published:started.add(name)
     absent=name not in started
     states[name]={'status':'NOT_STARTED' if child_done and absent else 'UNKNOWN_PRODUCER_OR_STARTED_WITHOUT_UNIT','properties':guard,'producer_file_observed':published}
     done=done and child_done and absent
     continue
    executing=int(guard.get('MainPID','0') or 0)>0 or int(guard.get('ExecMainPID','0') or 0)>0 or guard.get('ActiveState')=='activating'
    if executing:started.add(name)
    if name not in started:
     states[name]={'status':'UNEXECUTED_UNIT','properties':guard};done=done and child_done
     continue
    final=directory/('observer-final.json' if name=='observer' else 'guard-final.json')
    released=False
    if final.is_file() and not final.is_symlink() and final.stat().st_size<=2<<20:
     report=json.loads(final.read_text());released=int(guard['MainPID'])==0 and type(report.get('quiet_seconds')) in (int,float) and report['quiet_seconds']>=60
    states[name]={'status':'RELEASE60_OBSERVED' if released else 'WAITING_FOR_STARTED_GUARD_RELEASE','properties':guard}
    done=done and released
   if done:return {'status':'CHILD_EXIT_AND_STARTED_GUARDS_RELEASE60_OBSERVED' if started else 'CHILD_EXIT_KNOWN_GUARDS_NOT_STARTED','guard_states':states,'started_guard_names':sorted(started),'errors':errors,'normal_cleanup':False,'terminal_native_properties':state}
  except Exception as error:
   row={'type':type(error).__name__,'message':str(error)}
   if len(errors)<32 and (not errors or errors[-1]!=row):errors.append(row)
  if time.monotonic()+.2>=deadline:break
  time.sleep(.2)
 raise TimeoutError('owned abort/release not established within original wait budget')

claim(b['block_id']+'.claim')
ledger=[{**a,'status':'NOT_STARTED','condition_terminal':'NOT_STARTED','launch_requested':False,'attempted':False,'runtime_evidence_created':False,'returncode':None,'launch_error':None,'evidence_missing':None,'result_path':None,'result_sha256':None} for a in b['attempts']]
parent_started=time.monotonic();parent_end=parent_started+b['full_max_seconds']-3
status='FAILED_RETAINED_NO_RETRY';error=None
try:
 for index,a in enumerate(ledger):
  assert time.time()+(4-index)*7200+120<expiry,'remaining full block budget unavailable'
  p=pathlib.Path(a['command_path']);assert hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==a['command_sha256']
  c=json.loads(p.read_text());argv=c['argv'];specpath=pathlib.Path(argv[-3])
  assert hashlib.sha256(specpath.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==argv[-2]==c['spec_sha256']
  spec=json.loads(specpath.read_text());assert spec['status']=='FROZEN_EXECUTION_PLAN_REQUIRES_INDEPENDENT_REVIEW' and spec['run_id']==a['run_id']
  assert spec['source_commit']==b['source_commit'] and spec['protocol_sha256']==b['protocol_sha256']
